widget.name: Ax New Custom Table
widget.description: Data table backed by react-data-table-component with two modes. "Dynamic" (default) renders from a Header JSON + Data JSON pair, all loaded at once; paging, sorting and search run client-side. "Datasource" renders from Columns/Data Items datasources (typically a microflow/nanoflow) with action-driven paging and search: the widget writes the Offset/Limit/Filter attributes and then executes "On Fetch Data", which should refresh Data Items with the matching page.

property.caption: Data Mode
property.description: "Datasource" uses the Columns/Data Items datasources with server-driven paging. "Dynamic" renders from Header JSON + Data JSON, all loaded at once; paging, sorting and search then run client-side, and Scroll Mode chooses between pages and virtual scroll.

property.caption: Scroll Mode (Dynamic)
property.description: Dynamic mode only. "Pages" shows the page footer and uses the Pagination settings below. "Virtual scroll" has no pages: all rows scroll in one window and only the visible rows are rendered, so very large data stays fast. In Virtual scroll the Pagination settings are ignored, rows have a fixed height (long text is truncated), expandable rows are not supported, and the scroll height comes from "Fixed Header Scroll Height" (in px).

property.caption: Header JSON
property.description: Dynamic mode. JSON array of columns, e.g. [{"header":"No","label":"No","width":50}]. "header" is the field name in Data JSON; "label" defaults to it. Optional: hidden (true hides the column), sortable, align, wrap, visible, formatType, formatPattern, minWidth, grow, badgeColors (for formatType "badge": {"pending":"orange","done":"green"}; tones blue/green/red/orange/purple/gray or #hex; common status words are colored automatically).

property.caption: Data JSON
property.description: Dynamic mode. JSON array of row objects, e.g. [{"RowKey":"1","No":"1","Name":"test"}]. Each row's "RowKey" field is its unique key. A row with "HasInvalid": true is disabled — greyed out, not clickable and not selectable (select all skips it).

property.caption: Is Loading
property.description: When true, the table shows its loading state. Works in both modes.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: Datasource describing the table's columns (usually from a microflow/nanoflow).

property.caption: Column Key
property.description: Matches a key in each row's Row Values JSON.

property.caption: Column Label
property.description: Header text shown for the column.

property.caption: Column Width
property.description: CSS width for the column, e.g. "120px". Unbound = automatic width.

property.caption: Column Sortable
property.description: Whether this column can be sorted (client-side, within the loaded page). Defaults to false when unbound.

property.caption: Column Visible
property.description: Whether this column is shown. Defaults to true when unbound.

property.caption: Data Items
property.description: Datasource containing the current page of rows.

property.caption: Row Key
property.description: Unique, stable identifier for the row (react-data-table-component keyField).

property.caption: Row Values (JSON)
property.description: JSON object mapping each Column Key to that cell's raw value, e.g. {"name": "Acme", "revenue": 1200.5}.

property.caption: Enable Pagination
property.description: Shows the page footer. In Dynamic mode it is ignored when Scroll Mode is "Virtual scroll".

property.caption: Pagination Mode
property.description: Datasource mode only. "Pages" shows react-data-table-component's built-in page footer and replaces rows every fetch. "Load more" hides the footer and appends rows via a Load More button, gated on Has More. Dynamic mode always uses pages (or Virtual scroll).

property.caption: Default Page Size
property.description: Initial number of rows per page. Ignored when Scroll Mode is "Virtual scroll".

property.caption: Page Size Options
property.description: Comma-separated list of selectable page sizes. Ignored when Scroll Mode is "Virtual scroll".

property.caption: On Fetch Data
property.description: Executed (no parameters) whenever page, limit or search text changes, after the attributes below have been written. Configure this microflow/nanoflow to read those attributes and refresh the Data Items datasource with the matching page of data. Datasource mode only.

property.caption: Offset Attribute
property.description: Written with (page - 1) * limit before "On Fetch Data" executes. Datasource mode only.

property.caption: Limit Attribute
property.description: Written with the current page size before "On Fetch Data" executes. Datasource mode only.

property.caption: Total Count Attribute
property.description: Read back after "On Fetch Data" resolves to compute Has More/total rows. If left unbound, Has More falls back to "this page returned a full page of rows". Datasource mode only.

property.caption: Filter Text Attribute
property.description: Written with the current search text before "On Fetch Data" re-executes; search also resets to page 1. Datasource mode only.

property.caption: On Selection Change
property.description: Executed whenever the selected rows change.

property.caption: On Row Click
property.description: Executed when a row is clicked.

property.caption: On Row Double Click
property.description: Executed when a row is double-clicked. Not fired for rows flagged "HasInvalid". Note that a double click also counts as two single clicks.

property.caption: Persist Table Head
property.description: Keep the header visible even while loading or when there is no data.

property.defaultValue: There are no records to display
property.caption: No Data Text
